fact: A 2021 drought scoping study states that no government institution in Namibia at present hosts NDVI or VCI products, though a locally run rangeland early warning initiative provides them and NDVI/VCI were used to classify drought-affected farms for the Dare-to-Care drought assistance fund.
title: Namibia: The Forecast-based Financing Southern Africa Project (FbF-SAP): A regional drought scoping study, synthesis report
publisher: Red Cross Red Crescent Climate Centre / Anticipation Hub
